signUp.description: You will confirm your email before signing in.

verify.body: Your email address is confirmed. You can continue to your dashboard.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.done: Password saved. Sign in with your new password.
reset.missingToken: This page needs the link from the reset email.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor check
twoFactor.description: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.

invite.title: You're invited
invite.body: Sign in or create an account with the invited email address to join.
invite.invalid: This invitation is invalid, expired, or for a different email address.

errors.EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED: Confirm your email first — we sent you a new link.
errors.PASSWORD_COMPROMISED: This password appeared in a data breach. Choose another one.
errors.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.INVALID_TOKEN: This link is invalid or has expired.
errors.LAST_OWNER: A workspace needs at least one owner. Transfer ownership first.
errors.OWNER_PROTECTED: Only an owner can change or remove another owner.
errors.NOT_OWNER: Only an owner can transfer ownership.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already a member of the workspace.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to do this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This item no longer exists. Refresh the page.
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
